value.rationale: The minimal non-polynomial spline knot system gives a natural stability invariant: worst-case noise amplification as two adjacent observations collide. The exact coefficient and change of spatial noise hotspot at the sharp algebraic threshold are structural and may guide adaptive meshing; unlike a mere unboundedness example, the result quantifies both size and location for a continuous parameter family.
